note: The four products on the shelf from 15 Nov 2026 (the owner removed PROfeel Salted Caramel from the five selected earlier that night). The owner selected each EAN directly in the Valio Aimo catalogue and confirmed its availability there; these exact entries are used, with no search for alternatives and no retail EAN substituted. This file names products for recognition, labels and display: it grants no purchasing authority (the signed rule set decides what may be ordered and is unchanged). The camera counts consumer units (count_unit); the catalogue sells in its sales unit; the two quantities are kept apart (backend/products.py).

selection.statement: EANs selected directly from the Valio Aimo catalogue; availability there confirmed by the owner; PROfeel Salted Caramel (6408430401260) removed from the inventory by the owner, 15 Nov

purchasing_authority: none: recognition and display only. Purchasing eligibility is the signed rule set (version 4: rye bread, natural yoghurt, lactose-free milk drink), unchanged. Shelf events stay observe-only; automatic cloud recognition grants no purchasing authority.

routing.note: A local detection whose score is at or below its product's kimi_at_or_below goes to the cloud model (Kimi) automatically in detection/repeat mode, once a local model trained for this set is running. This routing threshold is separate from the minimum score for showing a box (display_min_score). Values marked provisional are adjustable.
routing.conflict_note: Two local boxes of different products that overlap by at least this share of the smaller box are one object with conflicting classes: escalated, never counted twice.
routing.flavour_margin_note: provisional: a shake whose best flavour score is within this margin of another flavour's score is escalated even above its threshold
routing.scene_note: provisional: a cloud answer is reused only while the object's box and its crop stay the same (box IoU and mean absolute pixel difference of a small grey thumbnail)
routing.cloud_timeout_note: covers the vision model's two steps (38 s + 14 s at most)

text_matching.note: How readable package text is weighed (shelf_service/vision.py). Text is evidence, never a mandatory condition: a brand with its own flavour phrase decides by itself; everything else is matched against the labelled reference photos. Generic package words are never a conflict. A flavour or fruit word that belongs to another product (or to no product of the brand) contradicts a product and prevents that match.

excluded_products.label: PROfeel Salted Caramel shake
excluded_products.status: removed from the active inventory by the owner (15 Nov)
excluded_products.note: Not a product of this set: never a recognition candidate, enrolment option or count. Kept here so that a readable 'salted caramel' PROfeel is reported as not inventory (never as Strawberry or Mint Chocolate), and so that a local model trained with a Salted Caramel class keeps its original class indices: that class is not renamed or renumbered, its boxes go to the cloud check and are never counted.

local_model_coverage.rule: Explicit coverage map (15 Nov 06:40), replacing the rule that a local model must have a class for every active product. A local model may cover only some products and is never refused for that; missing classes never block installation or runtime checks. An active product is covered locally only through a verified class of the running model (its manifest's class order, written only from the trainer's export) and only where this map allows it ('local-when-mapped'); every other active product is covered by the automatic whole-frame cloud check of the recognition action. Classes keep their original indices and names: a class of a removed product (Salted Caramel) or an old product (archived sets) is recognised as not in the inventory, never counted and never purchasable; a class without a verified meaning keeps its number and the cloud check establishes the identity. Local detections at or below a product's kimi_at_or_below, conflicting or unmapped ones always go to the cloud check.
